messages:
sam-sdk: heads-up: saw a production-ish repro on emulator where auth refresh + aggressive retry policy causes connection-pool exhaustion and new requests stall. seems different from runBlocking issues.

sam-sdk: scenario: refresh endpoint slow (~800ms) and on 401 our retry policy does exponential backoff but starts multiple parallel retries for the same resource. after a minute dispatcher queuedCalls skyrockets and new calls queue behind stalled ones.

lina-qa: logs? small repro steps?

sam-sdk: minimal repro included below. run 40 concurrent requests that all get 401; token refresh is single-threaded but our logic currently spawns independent retry attempts per call instead of coalescing. logs:
```
I/OkHttp: runningCalls=32 queuedCalls=8
W/SDK: received 401 for /v1/generate
I/SDK: scheduling retry in 200ms
I/OkHttp: runningCalls=40 queuedCalls=20
// many retries pile up
```

sam-sdk: outcome: devices with small dispatcher limits (emulator default) hit the limit and later requests block >10s.

omar-platform: two mitigations: (1) singleflight/coalescing for token refresh so only one refresh happens and others await result; (2) limit concurrent retries per-host and prefer scheduling on a backoff queue that counts towards a soft cap rather than directly enqueuing to OkHttp.

lina-qa: singleflight sounds good. did you try it?

sam-sdk: yes - implemented a tokenRefreshLock with a CompletableDeferred that other callers await. that removed duplicated refreshes but didn't fully fix the storm because each call still immediately enqueued its retry request after refresh failure, causing a short burst.

omar-platform: then add a per-call retry-window that deduplicates short-window retries: if multiple callers would retry the same route within X ms, coalesce into a single retry or stagger them. Another simpler approach: when a refresh completes, release only N retry attempts immediately and enqueue others with jittered delays up to 500ms.

lina-qa: sounds testable. can we add an emulator job that simulates slowness at the auth endpoint and asserts queuedCalls never exceeds a threshold?

ci-bot: queued job: auth-retry-coalesce-emulator (id 11234).

sam-sdk: implemented change: (a) token singleflight, (b) retry admission controller with burst limit 6 and exponential jitter for spillover. local emu tests show queuedCalls stays <10 under load.

omar-platform: please also add metrics and an alert when dispatcher.queuedCalls > 25 so platform can triage early. ops-bot?

ops-bot: adding a lightweight gauge for okhttp.dispatcher.queuedCalls and runningCalls to the console. will create an alert runbook if it spikes.

lina-qa: I'll add a flaky test that asserts no request waits more than 2s under the auth-slow scenario across API 28-31. Also include a unit test that simulates N callers and verifies coalescing.

sam-sdk: opening PR with code + tests + notes in SDK docs about retry admission control and parity expectations with Java SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-kotlin/pull/2035

omar-platform: can we standardize the admission controller in the Java SDK too so both SDKs behave the same?

sam-sdk: yes I'll sync with the Java SDK owners.

lina-qa: will run CI runs once PR lands and report back. good catch - this would have been painful in low-resource mobile devices. :thumbsup:
